## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets the branch for the next release (such as `2.2`), not `main`.
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test case that fails without it.
- [ ] If a template in `fypp/` changed, `fypp/generate.sh` was run and the generated files are included.
- [ ] `fpm test` passes, and the documentation in `doc_API_design/` reflects any change to the interface.
- [ ] A user-visible change has a line in the next release's section of `CHANGELOG.md`.
